skill.summary: Identify trending audio, viral formats, and meme templates relevant to your product category and help adapt them for ecommerce content quickly.

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 — Adds foundational templates and references for trend evaluation.

- Added four new reference and template files: trend log template, output template, trend evaluation matrix, and trend type glossary.
- Enhanced documentation to support structured trend analysis, adaptation, and content planning.
- No changes to the main skill logic; update focuses on workflow resources and quick-reference materials for users.
